html:
A Roman general who was the strongest man in the Western Roman Empire from 433 to 454. As a youth he had lived as a hostage among the Visigoths and the Huns, and he used his Hun friends as hired troops for much of his career.

He spent two decades holding the west together by war and bargaining with the peoples settled inside it: Visigoths, Franks, Burgundians and others. He fought the empress regent Galla Placidia and her generals for control of the court, and won.

His greatest moment came in 451. When Attila invaded Gaul, Aetius gathered Romans, Visigoths and other allies and stopped him at the Battle of the Catalaunian Plains. In 454 the emperor Valentinian III, fearing his power, killed him with his own hands at a meeting in the palace. Aetius's followers killed Valentinian the next year, and soon after the Vandals sacked Rome. He is often called "the last of the Romans".
sum: A Roman general who was the strongest man in the Western Roman Empire from 433 to 454. As a youth he had lived as a hostage among the Visigoths and the Huns, and he used his Hun friends as hired troops for much of his career.
